verdict.rationale: Formant documents exporting telemetry through the Cloud SDK for data scientists, and remote commands such as running a script on a device. These are building blocks a developer could assemble into an ML loop. Nothing in the pack documents a model-training integration or a model deployment or rollout mechanism back to the fleet.

support.subject: As a developer, I can feed collected robot data into model training and deploy the improved model back to the fleet
